revision: d25cbed plus bounded TAP USO input and temporary stage timing
profile: one socket; eight workers per daemon and four single-core load processes, CPUs 0–19
method: Complete monotonic-second bins only. Each sampled turn calibrates one clock interval with consecutive reads; each stage's accumulated clock baselines are subtracted after aggregation. Tiny negative dispatch residuals remain visible. No nested TAP-write timing. Counts cover every turn, not just sampled turns. No concurrent build/test jobs during these measurements.
stages: receive processing including interleaved TAP delivery
count_columns: TAP read handler calls without an available TX buffer
caveat: Instrumented measurements; approximate CPU attribution, not the production throughput gate. Independently started runs may differ in kernel scheduling.
